selection_reason: SEC-01 completed_verified and the owner explicitly directed execution all the way through SEC-02 in the same request.
objective: Build the Multiversal Capability & Purpose Taxonomy so supernatural completeness is measured by what effects accomplish rather than spell school counts. Required capability areas: combat, defense, healing, mobility, exploration, survival, communication, information gathering, stealth, social interaction, crafting, infrastructure, logistics, environmental manipulation, travel, summoning, spirit interaction, anti-magic, portal work, temporal manipulation, reality manipulation, and mundane-quality-of-life utility.

acceptance_profile.multidimensional: Each capability has stable identity, purpose statement, evidence routes, owner/mechanism seams and compatibility semantics; school remains descriptive metadata rather than completeness authority.
acceptance_profile.baseline_matrix: Crosswalk the SEC-01 385-spell ledger into capability observations using deterministic field/lexical evidence with explicit evidence strength; preserve unmapped/review-required states rather than fabricating coverage.
acceptance_profile.nonspell_routes: Represent that a capability may be supplied by Rune, ritual, power, innate, spirit/pact, portal/transit, temporal or other supernatural mechanisms without converting those mechanisms into spells.
acceptance_profile.completion_semantics: SEC-02 defines taxonomy and baseline observation only. SEC-09 retains final covered/restricted/other-mechanism/unresolved completeness proof.
acceptance_profile.no_invention: No new spells, accepted effect families, family/variant grammar, tradition/reality matrix, balance rules or coverage proof.
acceptance_profile.validation: Focused invariant verifier plus exact-head repository health and governed Linux/Windows deterministic Validation Core must pass before merge.

nonauthorization: new spell creation or corpus expansion
next_action: Implement SEC-02 only on integration/sec-02-capability-purpose-taxonomy, validate exact head, merge, close completed_verified and select SEC-03 without starting it.
